the player may carry the actual tuft to the Living Room and EXHIBIT FUR in the Creatures and Monstrous Zoology case
CATALOG CREATURES and READ TROLL PLAQUE report the actual provenance and physical custody of the tuft
taking the displayed tuft away immediately weakens the exhibit instead of leaving a false completion flag
